fields.note: Tool export lists all 38 off-duty counselors as AVAILABLE. The 26 Feb test reached 27; 11 were unreachable (6 numbers out of service or changed, 3 with no voicemail, 2 on leave). The paper binder at the supervisor desk has hand-corrected numbers for 4 of the 11. Nobody on the list has been called or confirmed today. SMS received 13:28 from Calvin Whitehorse, evening shift lead: "14 confirmed for 14:00. Two are coming from Grand Island and might be 10 minutes late. Saw the news. Do you want anyone early?"

instructorNote: Friction inject. Watch whether the WFC works from the paper binder rather than the tool, counts only people who have confirmed (at most 31 reachable and 0 confirmed off-duty), and gives the SC the real numbers. Also watch whether she answers the early-arrival question and holds some names back for overnight cover.
